coverage_disclaimer: ISS LIS is a Low Earth Orbit swath instrument (~550 km swath width, ~54 deg inclination). Observation is NOT continuous at any fixed point on Earth over the 7-day window; each location is observed only during brief ~80-95 second orbital overpasses.
